llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the tap target under `GestureHandlerRootView` and attach gestures with `GestureDetector gesture={...}` from `react-native-gesture-handler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses legacy TapGestureHandler component, not GestureHandlerRootView + GestureDetector with gesture={...} prop.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define both gestures with `Gesture.Tap()` builders (`singleTap` and `doubleTap`) using current builder callbacks (`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No Gesture.Tap() builders used; uses legacy TapGestureHandler components. No onEnd callbacks. useAnimatedGestureHandler not present but neither are the required builder APIs.
evidence: TapGestureHandler with onGestureEvent prop instead of Gesture.Tap().onEnd(...)

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` inside tap `onEnd` success paths to update React state and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: scheduleOnRN is never called anywhere in the submission; tap handlers call plain functions directly. runOnJS is also absent but the required scheduleOnRN pattern is missing.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compose taps with `Gesture.Exclusive(doubleTap, singleTap)` so exclusivity is defined by RNGH composition APIs.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.Exclusive() is never used; exclusivity is attempted via nested TapGestureHandler components and shouldCancelWhenStarted prop.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure tap-recognition windows via `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(2).maxDelay(...)` for double tap and `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(1)` for single tap, with explicit duration limits via `maxDuration(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(2).maxDelay(...) or Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(1).maxDuration(...) builder chains present. Uses legacy prop-based API (maxDurationMs={250} on TapGestureHandler).
evidence: no maxDuration(...) or maxDelay(...) builder calls found
